Wrap up the finished build: the text after /kit-wrapup in my message
Run after the rep's last /fix is approved. Read docs/lessons/README.md first: its placement order (1 a check, 2 a template or token, 3 the command file, 4 docs/lessons/<topic>.md or a rules file that already holds the topic, 5 CLAUDE.md last, one in, one out) decides where every lesson goes.
Gather the lessons the rep produced that aren't placed yet: design/reviews/review.md and the fix notes, design/known-gaps.md, the spec's fallback register and decisions by visual ID, and the rep's commits (`git log`). Skip what is already placed. List them in one table: Lesson | Rep | Where it goes (1-5) | Why not higher. List the CLAUDE.md (and command-file) rules a check added during the rep now enforces, with the check that enforces it, to retire.
Then record them: write each lesson where the table puts it, naming the rep (`(Rep 9)`); a check is a `pbik validate` rule or a test, and it must pass on the rep. A CLAUDE.md lesson retires or moves another, and CLAUDE.md stays under 150 lines. Run `python tools/copilot/sync.py` if CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules or .claude/commands changed.
Show me `git diff` and wait for my approval. Don't commit before it. If I turn a lesson down, undo just that edit. After approval, run `python tools/run_tests.py --regression`, fix real failures, and commit ("wrapup: Rep <n> lessons"). Then say what changed.
